gloss: peaceful and uneventful; safe and sound

definitions.gloss: peaceful and uneventful; safe and sound; tranquil
definitions.explanation: A state in which nothing troublesome or dangerous occurs; everything proceeds calmly and without incident.

examples.japanese: {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}な⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。

{平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らせる→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|しあわ}せだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{年|とし}を{重|かさ}ねる→年を重ねる：20549_toshiwokasaneru⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: With each passing year, I feel more that being able to live peacefully and without trouble is the greatest happiness.

notes:
FORMATION: A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) composed of ⟦{平穏|へいおん}→平穏：12446_heion⟧ (peaceful, calm) + ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧ (without incident, safe). Both halves reinforce the same meaning.

USAGE: Used as a na-adjective ({平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}な) or adverbially ({平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). Often expresses gratitude or a wish for continued peace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a peaceful life
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time peacefully
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end without incident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}: peaceful and incident-free (four-character compound)
- ⟦{平穏|へいおん}→平穏：12446_heion⟧: peaceful, calm (shorter form)
- ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧: safe, without incident (shorter form)
- ⟦{安泰|あんたい}→安泰：12301_antai⟧: safe and secure, stable
